tooltips.salaryRate: Reference only. Pay is PER WORK DONE: rates are set per work in Quick Start and the rate matrix. Shift hours feed statistics.
tooltips.status: Hired = can be assigned to work. On leave and Dismissed are not offered in Quick Intake.
tooltips.onShift: Set by clocking in/out. Read-only — use the Shift record or the Shift dashlet.
tooltips.language: Tablet language once the employee has signed in with the PIN.
tooltips.workRole: Tablet "Take" assigns only this role's works. When empty, every free work.
tooltips.pinSetAt: The PIN itself is never stored or shown, only its hash. Change it on the employee card or in Administration → Tablets.
tooltips.pinLockedUntil: After several wrong PIN entries sign-in is blocked for a while.

labels.pinHint: 4–6 digits. The PIN is not visible or recoverable — a forgotten one can only be replaced.
labels.pinInvalid: PIN must be 4–6 digits, not all the same and not sequential.
